notes.title: Updated Glow to version 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey folks, we have just updated Glow to version 1.0.3.
This new version includes the following features and fixes:
[list]
    [*]Allow to invert crosshair Y-axis via game settings menu (via "O")
    [*]Updated the mini help screen (via "F1")
    [*]Updated start screen to show all heavy attack modifier keys (Shift/Ctrl/Alt)
    [*]Fixed two minor cosmetic bugs
[/list]
Please let us know if you find anything we should be aware of.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Epic Showcase: Interview with Glow Developers
notes.content:
Recently we gave an interview to Daniel from Epic Games, creators of the Unreal Engine 4, the engine we use for Glow. In that interview we explain the history of the game and describe various (also technical) aspects of developing Glow.

So if you are interested in some background information on Glow, you can find the interview [url=https://www.unrealengine.com/showcase/glow-shines-the-light-on-unreals-ability-to-empower-small-development-teams]here on Epic's Showcase page[/url].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26474446/28aa3004b0ee75ee9854b5d391152cf25b87d606.png[/img]
